name: Prairie blazingstar
desc: Prairie blazingstar (Liatris pycnostachya): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Liatris pycnostachya, the prairie blazing star, cattail gayfeather, Kansas gayfeather, or cattail blazing star, is a perennial plant in the Asteraceae family that is native to the tallgrass prairies…
